Two hints supply topic-specific content rather than general interaction support: “A mí me viene bien quedar a las...” and especially “Podemos llevar agua y...”. The examiner script provides a backup only for the route question; its remaining short questions offer limited support for sustaining four minutes with an A2 learner.

Anchor the opening more explicitly in the previous photograph by placing the friends beside the rental bicycles with their paper map. Use that location instead of “Sala de examen”. Give Marta a simple proposed route, meeting time and lunch preference, with optional follow-up questions, to make the interaction less dependent on the learner supplying every detail.
